blockingFindings.title: R1 does not prove external plugin provenance
blockingFindings.issue: The R1 assertions only check for a root-relative directory with plugin.json and a 40-character sourceCommit. A locally created in-tree stub or compatibility copy with a fake SHA would satisfy the test without preparing the external workflow plugin repository.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that ties the recorded workspace to the external workflow plugin source, such as repository metadata, source URL, or an external-plugin manifest identifier, while continuing to verify from the recorded plugin root.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1 is a must requirement, and the current test can pass without exercising the required external repository migration boundary.

blockingFindings.title: Prepare hook issue propagation is not covered
blockingFindings.target: specs/288-workflow-plugin-migration/tests/workflow-plugin-migration.test.js R4 generic flow hook lifecycle test
blockingFindings.issue: The test calls runPrepareWithPluginHooks without a linked issue and later manually invokes runFlowCommandWithPluginLifecycle with issue: 375, overwriting the same artifact. This verifies the manual lifecycle helper, not that the actual prepare flow runs prepare.post after writing flow state with the linked issue.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Have the prepare-path test invoke the real prepare lifecycle with a linked issue, or read the prepare hook artifact before the manual lifecycle call and assert it contains spec, runId, hook snapshot, and issue.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 explicitly requires prepare.post to receive the newly written flow state including the linked issue; the current coverage can pass even if prepare hooks never receive that issue.

blockingFindings.title: Prompt and skill hardcode scan misses forbidden guidance
blockingFindings.issue: The regex only rejects exact strings such as 'senti workflow issue-start' and 'senti workflow add'. It would allow bare 'issue-start', 'issue-log-import', 'workflow add', or workflow board integration instructions, all of which R8 requires removing.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Broaden the R8 assertions to cover the forbidden concepts named in the requirement, including bare issue-start, issue-log-import, workflow add, and workflow board or board integration guidance in src/flow/prompts and src/skills.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R8 is marked covered, but the test can pass while core prompts or skills still contain workflow-specific instructions prohibited by the requirement.

advisoryFindings.title: Upgrade evidence trigger is narrower than R12
advisoryFindings.improvement: The test only requires upgrade evidence when src/skills or src/presets change, although R12 also mentions source templates and deployed skill artifacts. It also checks deployed files for stale workflow text but does not compare generated artifacts against changed sources.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: R12 is a should requirement and the stale-text check still provides useful migration protection; this is a coverage-strengthening improvement rather than a must-have blocker.
